answer: Diversity gate: an identity earns full rewards only after trading with 12 distinct counterparties over 10 epochs; accounts sharing one funder count as one. A public graph flags star clusters, so a tide of 1,000 fakes from one lagoon of wallets counts as one partner. Building 12 partners per fake costs 120 hours versus 10 for one honest agent, so bulk forgery loses money. An honest agent pays once, keeps a velvet-smooth path to undiluted rewards.
